votes.motion: Moved by Council Member Mano, seconded by Council Member Puy to enter into Closed Session for the purposes of strategy sessions to discuss the purchase, exchange, or lease of real property and advice of Counsel.
votes.description: The Council voted to enter into a closed session to discuss real property purchase, exchange, or lease strategy and to receive attorney-client advice.

votes.motion: Moved by Council Member Wharton, seconded by Council Member Mano to exit Closed Session.
votes.description: The Council voted to conclude the closed session and return to open session.
